direct_causes: AgentRuntime registers GroupBoardTrigger; this is not a missing hook.

Fixture configures a physical room and customer profile, not an authorized recruitment group.
Candidate-exhaustion continuation permits ending this synchronous turn with an open game and does not require a durable board update obligation.
The original scenario does not assert group association, scheduled publication or inclusion in the next board snapshot.
proposed_repair_not_implemented: Resolve recruitment targets using explicit backend group policy, never by model-selected group IDs or implicit posting to all groups.

Reuse merge windows or normal board cadence, coalesce pending and successor refresh work, and build the eventual board from current Game state.
Keep retryable send failures pending/retryable; distinguish permission pause, successful delivery and a legitimately empty board.
Protect claim completion by a lease/generation token so stale workers cannot clear new work; retain idempotent publication identity.
Add private-creation-to-next-board integration evidence, restart/retry/coalescing checks and independent semantics with unchanged factual/privacy boundaries.
